titulo_original: In the Heart of the South

sinopsis.es: In the Heart of the South es lo que sería Single White Female si ocurriera en Toronto, con una protagonista inuk y una pizca de elementos sobrenaturales, con Anna Lambe, de North of North.
sinopsis.en: In the Heart of the South is what Single White Female would be if it were set in Toronto, with an Inuk protagonist and a dash of supernatural elements, starring North of North’s Anna Lambe.
